atoms.sound: I am looking for online articles that support my opinion about social media’s negative effects on mental health.

instruction.text: Which article is most suitable for Ana?

atoms.text: Social media plays an important role in the lives of many teenagers. They use social media to communicate, share photos and watch videos. However, research shows that social media can affect how they feel. Studies report that teenagers who spend many hours on social media are more likely to feel stressed or anxious.

b: ++studies to learn new information
personal opinions on a topic
asking friends what they think
collecting information from social media

atoms.a: What is one effect of social media mentioned in the paragraph?
b: ++some teenagers feel more stressed or anxious
teenages stop using technology completely
social media improves teenagers’ stress level
teenagers end up sleeping less at night

atoms.text: Additionally, social media use can affect sleep and focus. Many teenagers use their phones late at night, which makes it more difficult for them to fall asleep. Experts explain that this is because of exposure to blue light from phones, which keeps the brain awake. This can lead to less rest overall and affect how well teenagers function the next day. As a result, they may find it harder to concentrate in class and complete their schoolwork.

atoms.a: How can social media affect teenagers’ sleep?
b: ++It makes it harder for them to fall asleep.
It helps them have longer sleep at night.
It has no effect on teenagers’ sleep.
It exposes them less to blue light.

atoms.a: Which statement is true according to the paragraph?
b: ++Poor sleep can make it harder to focus at school.
Teenagers focus better when they sleep less at night.
Phone use helps teenagers concentrate better at school.
Exposure to blue light has a positive effect on the brain.

atoms.text: Also, social media can lead teenagers to compare themselves to others. This is because they see pictures that show only the best moments of other people’s lives. A national health survey found that 1 in 3 teenagers said social media sometimes made them feel worse about themselves. These feelings can increase stress and lower confidence.

atoms.sound: what does SURvey most likely mean?
b: ++a set of questions used to collect information from many people
a list of facts found in a book or an article
personal opinions shared online about the same topic
a detailed report written by experts on a specific topic

atoms.a: What did the national survey find?
b: ++Some teenagers feel worse about themselves because of social media.
Teenagers who are affected negatively by social media stop using it completely .
Social media improves teenagers confidence, happiness and body image.
There are teenagers affected by social media, but the number is low.

instruction.text: Listen and choose the sentence that describes the main idea of the article.

b.sound: Social media can affect teenagers’ feelings, sleep and focus.
Social media is only used for entertainment and online games.
Teenagers should never use technology because it’s harmful for their mental health.
School is not important for teenagers since social media can replace it.
